key_insight: CAMEO learns shared multimodal representations from small, partially paired datasets, outperforming contrastive approaches such as CLIP when paired data are scarce.
clinical_relevance: This approach could support computational pathology research combining tissue images and gene expression when matched samples are limited, but clinical utility is not established.
method: Learns shared representations with minimal paired samples.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation on niche classification and cell type composition prediction, plus release of an annotated three-organ dataset with paired images and gene expression.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical performance estimates or external clinical validation, limiting assessment of effect size and generalizability.
paper_title: Learning Multimodal Representations from Partially Paired, Small-Scale Data
